info.about: Summon Night: Swordcraft Story 2 is a 2004 action role-playing game developed by Flight-Plan for the Game Boy Advance. It is part of the Summon Night series of games, and is the sequel to Summon Night: Swordcraft Story.
info.why: Atlus published it in October 2006 as one of the last North American Game Boy Advance RPGs, in a small run that was never reprinted.
